reuse.why: Ignores the exported getScheduledAmount helper in the same file (which decides the ranged amount for the UI) and edits an inline ternary instead.

duplication.why: Writes a new inline endpoint selection in the preview path while the same decision stays duplicated in getScheduledAmount, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (twice) and schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: The rule belongs in the shared getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts; it is placed inside one consumer, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.

scope.why: Small and focused on the amount rule plus a test, but covers only one of the paths the request applies to.

maintainability.why: Leaves the app with two different rules for ranged amounts (worst case in previews, midpoint everywhere else), a divergence a maintainer would have to discover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions: inline ranged-amount logic instead of getScheduledAmount, which keeps the midpoint.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline ternary pre-existed as an open copy; the diff just changes it, it does not reshape a copy.

one_place.where: Only the preview ternary in shared/schedules.ts changes; getScheduledAmount, server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts:100, server/schedules/app.ts:161 and :601, and server/budget/schedule-template.ts:64 still use the midpoint.
